selection_process: Part A Reasoning and Data Interpretation 30
Part A Indian Constitution, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English Comprehension 30
Part B Mechanical Engineering-related Subjects and Applications 120

The selection process includes a competitive examination conducted through Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) or OMR mode. The examination consists of objective-type multiple-choice questions divided into Part A and Part B. Further selection procedures will be conducted according to the Board's recruitment rules.
The examination contains 210 questions carrying 210 marks
with a total duration of 180 minutes. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for an incorrect answer. The minimum qualifying standard is 40% separately in Part A and Part B
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the Gujarat Government's OJAS portal. Before applying, candidates should identify the correct advertisement and keep their educational, identity and category certificates ready.
Visit the official OJAS website at ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Open the online application section and locate the GSSSB Additional Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) recruitment.
Read the recruitment instructions and complete the application form.
Enter personal, educational and category details as recorded in the supporting certificates.
Upload the required photograph and signature in the prescribed format.
Confirm the application and save the confirmation number.
Pay the applicable examination fee online before 12 November 2026.
Download or print the confirmed application and payment receipt for future reference.

Candidates should ensure that the application is properly confirmed and that the required examination fee has been paid. Incorrect information or failure to complete the prescribed process may result in rejection.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Additional Assistant Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for GSSSB Additional Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) posts must satisfy the educational qualification, computer knowledge, language and age requirements prescribed in the respective notifications. Applicants must possess a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from the Technical Examination Board, Gujarat, a recognized university or institution, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the government. The Ports and Transport Department has also accepted a Diploma in Automobile Engineering as an equivalent qualification through its communication dated 8 September 2026. In addition, candidates must possess basic knowledge of computer applications as prescribed under the applicable Gujarat Civil Services rules and adequate knowledge of Gujarati, Hindi or both. The minimum age for GSSSB AAE Recruitment 2026 is 18 years, and the maximum age is 33 years as on 9 November 2026. Age relaxation is available for eligible categories according to Gujarat Government rules. Age relaxation for candidates with disabilities depends on the category and applicable rules. Candidates seeking reservation benefits should check the certificate and domicile-related conditions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) under the Ports and Transport Department for filling technical positions in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The vacancies are announced for the position of Additional Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) under advertisement number 463/202627.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies advertised for the Additional Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) post across various eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from the Technical Examination Board, Gujarat or a recognized university, or a Diploma in Automobile engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 and 33 years as on 9 November 2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 49,600 for the first 5 years of probation, followed by regular pay scales upon satisfactory completion.

faq.question: Q7. When is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 9 November 2026, and candidates must submit their forms and fees on or before this date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for unreserved candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-, which is refundable upon appearing for the examination.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a competitive examination conducted via CBT or OMR method consisting of Part-A and Part-B, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official Gujarat OJAS portal at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in before the designated deadline.
